answer: Bandwidth-witness pairing: each epoch a beacon assigns every identity 3 random peers, and each must upload 8 MB of seed-derived data to them within 20 seconds, with receivers signing receipts. A farm hosting 50 fake identities on one uplink needs 1200 MB moving in the same window, so the link must grow linearly with each added key, like a trellis adding a frame for every willow shoot. Honest users find a safe haven in modest home connections. Receipts are public, so anyone verifies throughput.
